note: Fingerprinting is probabilistic, never proof. Every match carries a confidence and a how-to-verify step. Unknown hosts stay Unknown. Community PRs welcome: add a pattern with evidence, never a guess.

patterns.fix: Give n8n its own bot: BotFather → /newbot → paste the NEW token into n8n's Telegram credential only. Never share one token between n8n and your poller.
patterns.label: n8n workflow (Telegram Trigger)
patterns.verify: Open your n8n instance → Workflows → Telegram Trigger → check which bot credential it uses.

patterns.evidence: Host or path hints at an OpenClaw-style agent gateway
patterns.fix: Stop ALL OpenClaw gateways, wait a minute, then start exactly one. Do not just restart one copy.
patterns.label: OpenClaw / hosted agent gateway
patterns.verify: Check every machine / VPS where OpenClaw runs — local laptop, VPS, container — and stop all gateways before starting one.

patterns.fix: Kill the stale ngrok process, then point the webhook at your real deploy (or delete it to go back to polling).
patterns.label: ngrok tunnel (someone's local machine)
patterns.verify: A tunnel URL only lives while someone's ngrok process runs. Ask teammates, or check your own old terminal sessions.

patterns.fix: Redeploy the correct service, or delete the webhook and restart your poller.
patterns.label: Railway deploy
patterns.verify: Check your Railway project → Deployments — is this the deploy you expect, or a stale one?

patterns.fix: Redeploy the correct project, or delete the webhook and restart your poller.
patterns.label: Vercel deploy
patterns.verify: Check your Vercel project → Deployments — is this the deploy you expect?

patterns.fix: Redeploy the correct service, or delete the webhook and restart your poller.

patterns.fix: Redeploy the correct app, or delete the webhook and restart your poller.

patterns.fix: Fix the Hookdeck destination, or delete the webhook and restart your poller.
patterns.label: Hookdeck endpoint (webhook relay)
patterns.verify: Check your Hookdeck console — which destination does this endpoint forward to?

patterns.fix: Fix or delete the Hooklistener endpoint, or delete the webhook and restart your poller.
patterns.label: Hooklistener endpoint (webhook debugger)
patterns.verify: Check your Hooklistener dashboard — is this endpoint still yours and still forwarding?

patterns.fix: Delete the test endpoint, or delete the webhook and restart your poller.
patterns.label: webhooks.cc endpoint (webhook tester)
patterns.verify: Check your webhooks.cc dashboard — is this endpoint still yours?

patterns.evidence: Webhook URL uses a bare IP, not a hostname
patterns.fix: Point the webhook at your real domain, or delete it and restart your poller.
patterns.label: Bare IP address (likely a VPS / server)
patterns.verify: Check your servers / VPS list — which one serves this IP?
